bugs.what: Ashwood navigation is extremely repetitive with many near-identical rooms (Bare rock, Gray light, Cold woods, A deer trail, A hush) making it impossible to track location or find an efficient path back to the village
No clear shortcuts or navigation aids between distant locations (barrow and village). After defeating the ash wolf, had to backtrack 10+ turns and got hopelessly lost in identical forest rooms
The 80-turn limit was hit without any warning or indication that I was running out of time

confusions: Why do so many Ashwood rooms have near-identical descriptions? (Bare rock, Cold woods, Gray light appear many times)
How is the player supposed to efficiently navigate back to village from barrow after exploring?
The verses (drowned chapel, watchtower) were never found or explained - quest path unclear
suggestions: Make Ashwood rooms visually distinct - each location should have unique description
Add landmarks or navigation shortcuts (fast travel, clear map, distinctive markers) for Ashwood
Reduce Ashwood repetition or add clearer wayfinding - many coordinates felt like copy-paste descriptions
Show turn counter or warn player as approaching 80-turn limit
